structured_output.summary: The getter follows the spec steps in order. RequireInternalSlot is a TypeError for non-objects and objects without [[ArrayBufferData]]. A detached buffer returns +0. A buffer with a max length returns that max, and a fixed-length buffer returns its byte length. The target went from 6 to 20 passing with no regressions. The one flagged item is step 3 (IsSharedArrayBuffer), which has no code and only a comment saying no shared data block can exist yet. That is a legitimate invariant, because there is no SharedArrayBuffer constructor and the buffer allocator sets no shared flag. It has no observable effect now, so I accepted it. When SharedArrayBuffer lands, this getter will need a real step 3 check.
